# IPTV Prime

> IPTV Prime (https://iptvprime.cloud/) provides commercial 4K IPTV subscriptions with 20,000+ live TV channels, live PPV sports, and 60,000+ on-demand movies and series across the United States, United Kingdom, and Canada.

## Core Service Overview
- **Website**: https://iptvprime.cloud/
- **Target Regions**: United States (USA), United Kingdom (UK), Canada
- **Channel Lineup**: 20,000+ live television channels (Sports, PPV, Entertainment, Movies, Kids, News, International)
- **On-Demand Library (VOD)**: 60,000+ movies and multi-season series in 4K UHD and Full HD
- **Simultaneous Streams**: 3 concurrent device connections per subscription
- **Server Infrastructure**: Regional edge nodes in New York, London, and Toronto with 99.9% uptime and EPG program guide
- **Free Trial**: 24-hour evaluation trial available before subscribing
- **Refund Policy**: 7-day satisfaction money-back guarantee

## Subscription Plans & Pricing
- **Monthly Pass (1 Month)**: $19.99 USD / £15.99 GBP / C$26.99 CAD
- **Quarterly Pass (3 Months)**: $49.99 USD / £39.99 GBP / C$67.99 CAD
- **Annual VIP Pass (12 Months — Best Value)**: $74.99 USD / £59.99 GBP / C$104.99 CAD

## Supported Devices & IPTV Players
- **Devices**: Amazon Firestick, Fire TV, Samsung Smart TV, LG Smart TV, Apple TV, iOS (iPhone/iPad), Android TV, Nvidia Shield, Android mobile, MAG boxes, Enigma2, Windows, macOS
- **Formats & Apps**: M3U playlist URL, Xtream Codes API, MAG Portal; compatible with TiviMate, IPTV Smarters Pro, IBO Player, VLC
